collection.title: Silicone Freezer Trays
collection.body_html: The secret to efficient meal prep is batch-cooking. Our silicone freezer trays allow you to freeze perfect, single-serving portions of homemade purees and baby food. The flexible, non-stick silicone makes it effortless to pop out a single cube for mealtime, and the included lids prevent freezer burn and contamination.
